name: 1939 Sheet Metal Products, LLC
old_description: When your furnace quits in winter or your AC can’t keep up with Cheyenne’s summer heat, you need a team that shows up fast and does the job right. Sheet Metal Products has been serving Southeast Wyoming since 1939 with quality-first HVAC service, custom sheet metal work, and local care you can count on.
about:
1939 Sheet Metal Products, LLC has operated in Cheyenne, Wyoming since its founding in 1939, making it the longest-running HVAC company in the area. The business is veteran-owned and today remains under local ownership led by Richard Clark, Tanner Weinberger, and Ryan Ingersoll, all raised in the region. What began as a sheet metal and heating operation has continued for over eight decades as a small, owner-operated team serving Southeast Wyoming.

The company provides residential and light commercial HVAC services — including furnace and air conditioning installation, repair, replacement, maintenance, and inspections — alongside in-house custom sheet metal fabrication. Its shop produces ductwork, vents, and specialty metal components, allowing tighter control over fit and turnaround. Additional offerings cover indoor air quality systems, mini-split installation, water heater service, air duct work, and home performance testing.

Customers range from Cheyenne homeowners needing emergency furnace repair during winter cold snaps to small businesses and property managers requiring dependable heating and cooling for daily operations. The firm's commercial work focuses on practical solutions for light commercial spaces, while residential projects address whole-home comfort, system upgrades, and air quality improvements.

The company emphasizes a quality-first philosophy captured in the maxim that "the bitterness of poor quality remains long after the sweetness of cheap price is forgotten." Its differentiators include owner-involved service — customers often work directly with an owner — fast scheduling often within a week, and fabrication capabilities built for Wyoming's extreme seasonal swings.

name: 1X® Technologies
old_description: The Original 1X®, is a global distributor and manufacturer of electrical equipment, wire, and cable, delivering innovative solutions in robotics, automation, networking, security, and utility power applications since our founding in 2015 with first use in commerce established on May 15, 2015. Our very first order on May 15th 2015 was for Robotics products, and we have expanded our wire and cable product offerings (like industry peers Igus, Belden, and ABB) to include advanced equipment, encompassing an array of advanced robotics, consumer electronics like smart speakers, and IoT-enabled systems, which are fundamentally wire and cable products—relying on our high-performance wiring, cabling, and magnet wire for power distribution, data transmission, and mechanical functionality, typically comprising 20-40% of material costs and up to 35-45% in robotics systems.
about:
1X Technologies is headquartered in Sheridan, Wyoming, and was founded in 2015 as a limited liability company registered in the state. The company's first commercial order, placed on May 15, 2015, was for robotics products, marking the start of its focus on wire, cable, and electrical equipment for advanced automation.

The company operates as a global distributor and manufacturer of electrical wire, cable, and equipment. Its custom capabilities include cutting, stripping, terminating, marking, shielding, overmolding, connectorization, wire harness assembly, braiding, armoring, mil-spec cable production, private-label packaging, and custom color coding. It also manufactures high-flex robotics cables, copper coils for motors and actuators, and integrated robotics systems such as quadruped robots, robotic arms, humanoid robots, and AGI-integrated platforms, alongside consumer electronics like smart speakers. The firm reports millions of feet of copper and aluminum conductors delivered annually and maintains distribution centers in California, Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Texas, and Wyoming.

1X Technologies serves a broad range of industries, including aerospace and defense, fusion energy and advanced nuclear, medical equipment, telecommunications, robotics and automation, cybersecurity hardware, wearable technology, consumer electronics, automotive, semiconductor manufacturing, and space exploration. Its customer base includes the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, U.S. Navy, NASA, and corporations such as Disney, Meta, Google, Apple, Tesla, and ABB.

The company emphasizes its slogan "Because You Require Quality, Quickly!" as a differentiator, citing the industry's fastest lead times, lowest minimum order quantities, and a dedicated manufacturer sales representative assigned to each account. Products undergo third-party testing by NRTLs including UL, CSA, and ETL, and the firm holds an Essential Critical Infrastructure designation from the Department of Homeland Security, ensuring continuous operation during emergencies.

name: 3D Plastics Inc
old_description: IceAlert has been partnering with 3D Plastics since 2007, and their contribution to our product line has been nothing short of exceptional. Over nearly two decades, they have consistently manufactured multiple critical components for IceAlert with the precision and quality our products demand. What sets 3D Plastics apart is not only the reliability of their workmanship, but the genuine partnership they bring to every project. Their team has demonstrated a deep understanding of our needs and an unwavering commitment to getting it right. After nearly 20 years of consistent, high-quality output that our business has depended on, their track record speaks for itself. I recommend 3D Plastics without hesitation to any company looking for a manufacturer they can build a lasting relationship with.
about:
3D Plastics Inc. operates from Newberg, Oregon, where it was founded in 2007 as a family-owned plastic injection molding company. The business draws on more than 75 years of combined team experience in project development, product design, and cost-effective manufacturing.

The company runs injection molding machines ranging from 18 to 310 tons, producing parts from one ounce up to 26 ounces (approximately 2 pounds). Capabilities include over-molding with threaded inserts, bushings, and metal or plastic substrates, plus in-house secondary operations such as ultrasonic welding, heat staking, pad printing, hot stamping, CNC machining, and 3D-printed prototypes. Tooling support spans prototype molds (under 500 cycles) to high-production tools exceeding one million cycles.

3D Plastics serves consumer, dental, medical, electrical, and industrial markets. Consumer work includes firework holders, magnifying lenses, and enclosures. Dental components cover caps, holders, handles, and light bezels. Medical projects involve gaskets, DNA holders, and housings. Electrical customers require tight-tolerance housings, electronic packaging, and complex components. Industrial parts are designed for stiffness under extreme pressure and heat. Long-term clients include IceAlert (since 2007) and FEC Source LLC for clear acrylic optical components.

The company positions itself as a single-source partner from concept to final delivery, emphasizing personalized service, full material traceability as a UL-certified molder, and a culture that prioritizes employees, suppliers, and customers alike.

name: 425 Fabrication Division and Mobile Welding
old_description: 425 Manufacturing is a leading provider of CNC milling, turning, engineering, and support services, serving clients across Rockford, Illinois, Southern Wisconsin, and the Chicagoland area. Our Fabrication Division, initially a value-added service for metal fabrication and welding, has now become one of our core strengths. Recently, we expanded to a 45,000 square foot facility in Rockford, IL featuring a 3-ton crane, a new 12′ x 14′ x 30′ heated paint booth, and extensive electrical capacity.
about:
425 Fabrication Division operates from a 45,000-square-foot facility in Rockford, Illinois. The division was formed in 2012 as part of 425 Manufacturing, which Mike and Michelle Thomason founded to provide general machining services and aftermarket parts for drilling equipment in the greater Rockford area. As community building projects brought steady fabrication work, the Thomasons established the Fabrication Division as a dedicated unit. The company remains family-owned and employee-driven, with the Thomason family active in local charitable giving.

The shop combines metal fabrication, welding, and precision machining under one roof. In-house welding includes MIG, TIG, stick, and arc gouging on stainless steel and aluminum, supported by a mobile welding rig for on-site repairs. Machining capacity comprises four CNC turning centers, four CNC machining centers, multiple knee and bed mills, manual lathes, and three surface grinders. A 3-ton overhead crane and two heated paint booths (one 12'×14'×30', another 14'×24'×14') handle large weldments. The division also runs a 3D printing lab for rapid prototyping and production parts, a CMM-equipped inspection room, and augmented-reality tools for design verification.

Customers span industrial heat-treat equipment builders, custom machine builders, drilling and mining, wind power, air and water filtration, food processing, paper machinery, power generation, aerospace maintenance, marine maintenance, semi-truck upfitters, retail fixture makers, and automotive suppliers. The division has developed a nationwide niche in aircraft static display mounting, delivering custom-machined components and precision-fit assemblies for museums and military bases. Emergency mobile welding has served fire departments and other fleets needing rapid, on-site repairs.

The Thomasons started the business to fill a local machining gap, and the fabrication division grew from demand for engineered structural solutions. The company emphasizes AWS-certified welding personnel, in-house engineering and 3D design, and a culture of community involvement—evidenced by donations such as 2,300 pounds of pet food to a local shelter.

name: ADCO International Plastics
old_description: Located in Metro Atlanta, Georgia, ADCO Plastics has been manufacturing custom injection molded assemblies and parts since 1974. We serve the medical, commercial, industrial, transportation, and retail markets with a wide range of commodity grade and engineered resins and thermoplastics rubbers.
about:
ADCO Plastics Corporation, based in Marietta, Georgia, has been producing custom injection molded assemblies and parts since its founding in 1974. The privately held company operates in the Metro Atlanta area and has grown to become a regional leader in mold building and value-added molding services.

The company runs 22 injection molding machines with clamping forces from 55 to 750 tons, capable of molding parts weighing 2 to 64 ounces. Its process portfolio includes insert molding, sonic welding, heat staking, pad printing, hot stamping, painting, and secondary machining such as cutting, drilling, and CNC milling. ADCO also provides full and sub-assembly, in-house mold building, product design and development, and PPAP documentation, supported by statistical process control and Six Sigma tools.

ADCO serves the medical, commercial, industrial, transportation, and retail markets, working with commodity resins, engineered resins, and thermoplastic rubbers. Customers range from medical device manufacturers to transportation and retail product companies.

The company emphasizes agile customer responsiveness, fast quoting and lead times, and value-added design and manufacturing as its core differentiators. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

name: AIM Processing
old_description: AIM Processing is a custom plastic injection molding company that specializes in small plastic parts—meaning anything between the size of your fingernail and your hand. If you’re looking for incredible attention to the finest details, technical experience throughout the development of your product and flexibility within your current and future orders, we can give you what you need.
about:
AIM Processing was founded in 1993 in Longmont, Colorado, by a toolmaker and a plastics processor who started with two presses. The company initially handled overflow and complex projects for other molders, building a reputation for difficult small-part work. In 2006, the founders retired and sold the business to the current management team.

Today, AIM operates 37 injection molding presses around the clock in a nearly 60,000-square-foot facility that includes a 40,000-square-foot production plant and an 18,000-square-foot finished-goods warehouse. The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding of small parts—defined as between the size of a fingernail and a hand—using a mix of automated lights-out production and press-side attended operations. Services include insert molding, overmolding, metal replacement, tooling and tool transfer, and secondary operations such as laser etching, ultrasonic welding, and assembly. Engineering support focuses on design for manufacturability. The firm has launched nearly 2,000 distinct small plastic parts for over 100 customers.

AIM serves manufacturers in agriculture, automotive, industrial manufacturing, electronics, medical, and safety and security sectors. Typical clients are manufacturers with 30–300 employees who need engineering support for new programs; many have been customers for a decade or more. Testimonials cite a medical device company president and an industrial product company quality manager.

The company emphasizes three attributes: determination, appetite for innovation and creativity, and focus on customer value through quality. It maintains ISO 9001:2015 registration, reports a 98%+ on-time delivery rate, and uses forecasting models so that over 85% of custom parts ship from stock. Its central Colorado location enables two-day ground shipping to 16 states.

name: Acadiana Textiles & Supply
old_description: Acadiana Textiles & Supply is a woman owned and veteran owned wholesale distributor serving businesses since 1997. Based in Lafayette, Louisiana, we supply wiping rags, oil absorbents, spill kits, packaging supplies, disposable protective garments, and related industrial products throughout the Gulf Coast region and beyond.
about:
Acadiana Textiles & Supply was founded in 1997 in Lafayette, Louisiana. The company is a woman-owned and veteran-owned wholesale distributor that has served businesses across the Gulf Coast region and beyond for over two decades. The company operates from its Lafayette headquarters and ships throughout the Gulf Coast and beyond.

As a wholesale-only distributor, the company supplies industrial wiping rags, oil absorbents, spill kits, packaging supplies such as stretch wrap, and disposable protective garments. Its product catalog includes specific lines such as 30120 polypropylene protective apparel, CGS428 Chem-Guard protective apparel, FGF127 Flash-GuardFR flame-resistant protective apparel, and DSP303 DanGuard protective apparel.

The customer base consists of approved business accounts including distributors, industrial suppliers, marine suppliers, janitorial suppliers, safety suppliers, and automotive parts stores. All purchases require account approval and a valid resale certificate, and the company does not sell to the general public or end users.

Acadiana Textiles & Supply states that its focus is on dependable service, flexible packaging options, competitive wholesale pricing, and building long-term customer relationships. The wholesale-only model is designed to support resellers and industrial supply chains rather than direct consumer sales.

name: Accumedix, Inc
old_description: Accumedix provides complete services to develop your ideas into innovative medical devices. We have been in operation since 2001 and are located in Libertyville, IL. Our Accumedix facility is FDA registered and has obtained ISO MDSAP and ISO 13485 and certifications for European Notified, UL, Medical Device Directive and FDA Quality System Reg. 21 CFR Part 820.
about:
Accumedix, Inc. was founded in 2001 and operates from Libertyville, Illinois. The privately held company is led by President Paul J. Serio, a medical device industry veteran with over 35 years of experience at Baxter Healthcare and Fenwal Blood Technologies, and Vice President of Regulatory Affairs and Quality Michele H. Kupcso, who brings similar depth from Baxter and Allegiance Healthcare. Serio joined after global IT acquisitions and SAP implementations, while Kupcso previously ran an international regulatory consulting firm.

The company provides end-to-end medical device commercialization services, spanning design and development, quality management system implementation, contract manufacturing, assembly and packaging, and distribution. Its Libertyville facility includes clean room and white room manufacturing environments capable of handling clinical trial runs through full production scale. Services include sterile packaging, sterilization coordination (including ethylene oxide requalification and quarterly dose audits), lot-controlled warehousing, and drop-shipping. Accumedix also offers a subscription-based quality management system that covers FDA and European management representation, annual registrations, audits, and supplier quality oversight.

Accumedix serves the medical device industry exclusively, working with customers ranging from individual inventors to Fortune 1000 companies. Its client engagements cover catheter assembly, electromechanical device assembly, and broader device commercialization programs that require regulatory submissions such as 510(k)s, European technical files, and FDA quality system compliance.

The company's stated mission is to develop and commercialize new medical device technologies while generating returns for investors through outstanding customer value. Accumedix differentiates itself by integrating regulatory and quality expertise directly into manufacturing, offering a quality system by subscription that aims to reduce compliance lead times from months to weeks, and by accepting assembly and packaging orders of any volume without minimum requirements.

name: Acme Wire Products Co., Inc.
old_description: Acme Wire Products specializes in precision fabrication of components, parts, and products. While much of our work focuses on industrial applications – everything and anything from stainless steel baskets and machine guards to medical carts and frames – we also produce consumer goods from sporting goods components to custom sink accessories.
about:
Acme Wire Products Co., Inc. was founded in 2000 in Mystic, Connecticut. The company began as a precision wire fabrication shop serving industrial and commercial markets.

Today the company specializes in CNC wire forming up to 1/2-inch diameter, 2D and 3D CNC wire bending, wire straightening and cutting, welding, CNC stamping and forming, electrostatic powder coating, and fluid bed coating. Materials processed include carbon steel, stainless steel, titanium, Inconel, and Monel in wire diameters from 0.060 to 0.50 inch. Standard diameters are stocked for faster turnaround, while custom sizes and alloys can be sourced as needed. The shop produces wire guard cages, industrial cleaning baskets, wire baskets, wireforms, frames, racks, filter support weldments, battery straps, wire bails, wire grids, fan guards, and complete custom wire fabrications.

Acme Wire serves medical and food processing, industrial and OEM, safety and HVAC, telecommunications and premise wiring, sporting goods, and material handling sectors. Examples include stainless steel baskets and medical carts for healthcare, cable management trays and routing rings for telecom infrastructure, wire facemasks meeting NOCSAE standards for sporting equipment, and custom wire baskets and trays for protecting parts during material handling.

The company emphasizes turnkey capabilities, expert craftsmanship, and ISO 9001 certification as key differentiators. It maintains stock of standard wire diameters to expedite manufacturing and offers customized wire sizes and materials to suit specific applications.

name: Aero Tech Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Aero Tech is an employee-owned manufacturer of truck mounts, precision sheet metal fabrication, and radiant ceiling panels engineered and built in-house for quality, control, and long-term performance.
about:
Aero Tech Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1967 in North Salt Lake, Utah. The company operates as an employee-owned business, a structure that the leadership says aligns accountability with day-to-day production decisions. It began as a precision sheet metal fabrication shop and has since expanded into multiple product lines.

Today the 84,000-square-foot facility houses custom sheet metal fabrication, powder coating and finishing, UL 508-listed industrial control panel assembly, electrical and pneumatic system integration, and electromechanical assembly. The shop supports both prototyping and full production runs, delivering components for truck mounts, radiant ceiling panels, and a range of industrial sub-assemblies.

The company serves customers in cleaning and restoration, aerospace and defense, medical and laboratory, industrial manufacturing, water and filtration systems, and material handling and automation. Professional cleaning contractors rely on its truck mount systems, while OEMs in aerospace and medical device sectors source precision sheet metal components and value-added assemblies.

Aero Tech emphasizes in-house control, with engineering, fabrication, and assembly under one roof to manage quality, timelines, and outcomes. The firm highlights its ISO 9001 certification, a five-stage cleaning and phosphate pretreatment system for coatings, and real-time project tracking as factors that differentiate its service.
